01 — What we do

Five ways we integrate EO into your work, from first question to everyday use.

Every engagement starts with your question and the data available to answer it. Most combine several of the services below, and end with a service your team runs on its own.

01
Environmental monitoring

Tracking ecosystem change, industrial impact and environmental compliance with EO, AI and in-situ sensor data.

Land degradation & vegetation changeSurface water monitoringChange analysis dashboards

03 — EO & AI capacity building

Adoption happens through experience, not presentations.

For insurers, lenders and public institutions, we run use-case training that shows where EO can strengthen underwriting, lending and investment decisions. We start by assessing current capacity, then train trainers, run workshops and brief decision-makers, leaving communities of practice that carry the work on after handover.

01
AssessMap current skills, needs and the decisions EO should support.
02
DesignSelect and tailor the modules that fit those needs.
03
TrainHands-on sessions built on your own use cases and data.
04
Hand overTrainers and a community of practice that carry it forward.
MODULE 01
Geospatial intelligence fundamentals

EO data capabilities and limitations, and how they can support your business, for technical staff and decision-makers alike.

MODULE 02
Trustworthy AI for risk decisions

Explore how AI turns EO data into risk signals, where models fall short, and how to check, validate and explain their outputs before acting on them.

MODULE 03
Insurance and finance applications

You choose the use cases: parametric products, underwriting decisions; due diligence, portfolio and exposure monitoring.

MODULE 04
Custom modules and focussed pilot

You set the priorities. We build modules around them and test them in a focused pilot, with a training option so skills spread across your organisation.
